**Paris Get‑away: A 7‑Day Itinerary (Mid‑Season, €1,200–€1,800 per person)** | Day | Morning | Afternoon | Evening | |-----|---------|-----------|---------| | **1 – Arrival & Orientation** | • Arrive at Charles de Gaulle or Orly.
• Take RER B to Gare du Nord → Metro Line 4 to **Châtelet** (or use a taxi/ride‑share).
• Check into a boutique hotel or Airbnb in the **Marais** (budget €80–120/night). | • Walk to **Place des Vosges** and enjoy a coffee at **Café Charlot**.
• Explore the Marais boutiques and art galleries. | • Dinner at **Le Petit Fer à Cheval** (French bistro).
• Night stroll along the Seine, see the Eiffel Tower sparkle. | | **2 – Classic Landmarks** | • Early breakfast at **Ladurée** on Champs‑Élysées.
• Visit the **Eiffel Tower** (skip‑the‑line ticket €25). | • Picnic lunch at **Champ de Mars**.
• Walk to **Arc de Triomphe** (ticket €12). | • Dinner at **Le Relais de l’Entrecôte** (famous steakhouse).
• Optional: Seine river cruise (night cruise €15). | | **3 – Art & Culture** | • Breakfast at **Café de Flore** (classic left‑wing café).
• Louvre Museum (ticket €17). | • Lunch at **Le Café Marly** overlooking the Louvre.
• Visit **Musée d’Orsay** (ticket €14). | • Dinner at **Septime** (reservation required; tasting menu €70).
• Attend a jazz club in Saint‑Germain‑des‑Près (e.g., **Le Caveau de la Huchette**). | | **4 – Day Trip to Versailles** | • Breakfast at the hotel.
• Take RER C to **Versailles Château** (ticket €20). | • Guided tour of the palace and gardens.
• Lunch at **La Petite Venise** inside the park. | • Return to Paris.
• Light dinner at **Bistro du Peintre** (budget €30). | | **5 – Montmartre & Hidden Gems** | • Breakfast at **Le Pain Quotidien**.
• Explore **Montmartre**: Sacré‑Coeur, Place du Tertre, and the artists’ square. | • Lunch at **Le Consulat** (historic bistro).
• Visit the **Dalí Paris** museum (ticket €10). | • Dinner at **Le Coq Rico** (chicken specialties).
• Sunset walk to the **Moulin Rouge** for a photo op. | | **6 – Shopping & Relaxation** | • Breakfast at **Café Kitsuné**.
• Shopping spree on **Rue Saint‑Honoré** and **Galeries Lafayette** (budget €150). | • Lunch at **L’Atelier de Joël Robuchon** (tasting menu €45).
• Relax at **Jardin du Luxembourg** or book a spa session at **Spa Nuxe** (€60). | • Farewell dinner at **Le Jules Verne** (Eiffel Tower restaurant, tasting menu €120). | | **7 – Departure** | • Pack and check out.
• Grab a croissant and coffee at **Du Pain et des Idées**. | • Last‑minute souvenir shopping at **Marché aux Puces de Saint‑Ouen** (if time). | • Head to the airport via RER B or taxi. | --- ### Budget Breakdown (per person) | Category | Cost (EUR) | |----------|------------| | Flights (round‑trip from US/EU) | 300–600 | | Accommodation (7 nights) | 560–840 | | Transport (metro, RER, occasional taxi) | 80 | | Attractions & Tours | 140 | | Dining (average €35/day) | 245 | | Miscellaneous (souvenirs, tips) | 100 | | **Total** | **1,225–1,705** | *(Prices are approximate and can vary by season and booking time.)* --- ### Practical Tips 1. **Transport Pass** - Buy a **Navigo Week Pass** (€22.80) for unlimited metro/RER travel within zones 1–2. - For day trips (Versailles), consider a **RER C single ticket** (€20) or a combined **Versailles + RER C** pass. 2. **Dining Reservations** - Book restaurants like **Septime**, **Le Jules Verne**, and **Le Petit Fer à Cheval** at least 2–3 weeks in advance. - Use apps like **OpenTable** or **LaFourchette** for reservations. 3. **Museum Tickets** - Purchase tickets online to skip queues. - Consider a **Paris Museum Pass** (€60) if you plan to visit 4+ museums. 4. **Language** - Learn basic French phrases: “Bonjour”, “Merci”, “Combien ça coûte?”, “Où est…?”. - Many locals speak English, especially in tourist areas. 5. **Safety & Health** - Keep your passport, credit cards, and travel insurance handy. - Carry a small first‑aid kit and bottled water. 6. **Packing** - Comfortable walking shoes (Paris streets can be cobblestone). - Light layers: Paris weather is unpredictable; bring a jacket and umbrella. - Power adapter (Type C/E for EU). --- ### Optional Add‑Ons | Activity | Approx. Cost | Notes | |----------|--------------|-------| | **Seine River Cruise (daytime)** | €15 | Scenic view of landmarks. | | **Cooking Class** | €80 | Learn to make croissants or macarons. | | **Wine Tasting** | €50 | Sample French wines in a local cellar. | | **Day Trip to Giverny** | €30 | Monet’s garden. | | **Nightlife** | €20–40 | Bars in Pigalle or Bastille. | --- Enjoy your Paris adventure! If you’d like more details on any specific day, or help with booking tickets and reservations, just let me know. Bon voyage!
